{{Quote|The Max Rebo Band.''"<br />"''Never heard of 'em.''"<br />"''You will. They're too good to play backwater dives like this for long.|[[Meck Odom]] and [[Kyle Katarn]] at the [[Blue Moon]]|audio=MaxReboBand-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''Max Rebo Band''', also known as '''The Max Rebo Twelve''' and (originally) '''[[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]]''', was among the most well known bands of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], thanks in part to their status as the regular band at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. The member's include, [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]], [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], and [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rappertunie]].

==History==
===Early history===
{{Listen|filename=Jedi Rocks.flac|title=The band performing "Jedi Rocks"|description=A short sample clip}}
Formed on the initiative of the [[Letaki]] would-be impresario [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], the band originally consisted of the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Siiruulian Phantele]] (stage name Max Rebo), the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]], and finally, the [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rappertunie]]. Performing as [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]], Snootles and Orbus would dazzle audiences with their impressive vocal talents as Rebo and McCool accompanied them on their instruments: the [[Nalargon/Legends|Red ball organ]] and a [[chidinkalu]] flute.<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

Touring small venues and cantinas in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], the Orbus-led group soon built up a following.<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> The band was responsible for many hits, including "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]," "[[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]]," and "[[(That Joyous Night) I Ate My Mate/Legends|(That Joyous Night) I Ate My Mate]]." Thanks to his shady contacts, however, Orbus was the only one to earn a profit.

In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the band played at [[Doodnik's Café]] on the planet [[Tyne's Horky]].

[[File:MaxReboBandEGC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The initial lineup of the band was a trio: Sy Snootles, Max Rebo, and Droopy McCool.]]
Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the band was playing at the [[Blue Moon]], a cantina and strip club in the rundown city of [[Trid]]. Located on the backwater world of [[Danuta]], the Blue Moon would frequently see Imperial officers from the Imperial research facility as denizens in their off hours.

When invited to play at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], the band leaped at the opportunity to gain greater fame. Unfortunately, [[Figrin D'an/Legends|Figrin D'an]], leader of the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]], took offense to the fact that Chalmun would hire a second band, and attempted to kill them. Orbus was the only one to perish in the ensuing melee, and the surviving members allowed the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] to keep the job.<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

===Changing their tune===
{{Quote|I could have killed Max &ndash; the little blue dope &ndash; and I'm a pacifist! All he had to do was look at the size of my mouth and my body to see that I don't eat much. Droopy wasn't happy, either. He eats only once a month! Jabba was going to pay us in food! But any boss worth working for pays the band and gives them a meal on top of it! I was wrong to let Max run our business affairs. After this fiasco, I vowed to leave and take Droopy with me. If that fool Rebo wants to work for food, then he should have a solo career.|[[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]|<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
[[File:DancingTrio-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dancers and backup singers Rystáll Sant, Greeata Jendowanian, and Lyn Me]]
Desperate for a new gig, the band needed to take a new direction. Snootles, knowing that Rebo could be easily manipulated, allowed him to become the new leader of the band. She did this in order to ensure that Rebo would provide a public target for any further assassination attempts while she managed the band from behind the scenes. Sy Snootles' first act was to bring in backup dancers [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]], [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]] and [[Lyn Me/Legends|Lyn Me]], in addition to fellow musicians [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]] (stage name Rappertunie) and [[Barquin D'an/Legends|Barquin D'an]], whose relationship to Figrin was irrelevant to the band.

Rebo, McCool, and Snootles met with [[Naroon Cuthus]], who allowed the band to audition for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Jabba was so impressed by their performance that he offered them a lifetime contract, with payment in the form of all the food the band could eat. Rebo immediately accepted the offer before the others could stop him. Snootles would later comment on how foolish she had been in letting Rebo act as the public face of the band, as it had led them to virtual eternal servitude.<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

[[File:Max_Rebo_Band.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Max Rebo Band performs in Jabba's Palace.]]
Still, their lives were not as bad as they had once been. They were allowed to travel outside the palace and accept tips from the palace denizens. They were sent to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to perform for [[Bingo Mehndra]] on the crime lord's Spawning Day. Unknown to the band, they were being sent to kill him. When McCool discovered [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]] explosives hidden in the speakers, the band set up a holovid that played a previous performance for Mehndra while they made their escape. In gratitude, Jabba bought them new instruments and gave them three new band members: the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]], the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Ak-rev/Legends|Ak-rev]], and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bard [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]].

The band played at Jabba's Palace during [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] attempt to free [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and later played at their execution over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The band barely escaped the catastrophe that followed, jumping to safety as the Sail Barge blew apart.<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> Greeata and Lyn Me then drove away a band of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], stealing their [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] to ride to civilization.

===Fallout===
[[File:Max_Rebo_fb.jpg|thumb|right|Max Rebo, Sy Snootles, and Droopy McCool perform in front of a [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-frozen]] Han Solo.]]
With their release from Jabba's contract, the band split apart. Rebo would eventually join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], playing for the troops and enjoying their food (which he claimed was his reason for joining in the first place). He would later relocate to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] recaptured it. Rebo also started a restaurant chain called [[Max's Flangth House]]. Yowza joined [[The Palpatones]], exchanging his singing talent for transportation across the galaxy. Greeata and Rystáll would also join the band, Greeata gaining fame with the hit "[[Kick the Ranat]]" and Rystáll leaving the band after meeting fellow [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Shug Ninx]]. D'an built up a thriving import business on [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]], while Rappertunie joined [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni]], designing upgrades for the [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6]] droid. Bodonawieedo would steal several sculptures from Jabba's Mos Eisley townhouse, selling them off and earning himself a fortune in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and Umpass-stay would become employed by [[Jocoro Desilijic Tiure]]. Lyn Me searched for her idol [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] after it was uncovered that Fett survived the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]].

The others were not as successful. Snootles would become a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addict, never able to reclaim her past fame. McCool wandered off into the desert wastes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and was never heard from again.<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> Ak-Rev was killed by a pack of Tusken Raiders who had taken offense at his fellow Weequay's habit of killing their banthas as sacrifices to the Weequay god [[Quay]].

==Behind the scenes==
The 1984 [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] action figure set listed this band's name as Sy Snootles and the Rebo Band.<ref name="SWCA">{{WebCite|url=http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=39670|text=Return of the Jedi Sy Snootles and the Rebo Band Action Figure Set|work=Star Wars Collectors Archive|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/VpASX}}</ref>
